description: Use this when you need a player_id or team_id, or the user names a player or team you have not resolved yet ('Jokic', 'Lamar Jackson', 'BOS'); it is accent- and typo-tolerant. Returns the matching NBA and NFL players and teams with their numeric ids and page urls. Not for stats: call player_profile or team_profile with the id.

league.description: Optional league filter ("nba" or "nfl"). Omit to search both leagues.

query.description: Player or team name or abbreviation (e.g. "Jokic", "Lamar Jackson", "BOS").

name: search
title: Search Players & Teams
